scripts.text:
[Noi]
Welcome to Ayothaya.
Our beautiful village is built
above the water, surrounded
by a dense forest.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
欢迎来到哎哟泰雅。
我们美丽的村庄建在水面上，四周环绕着茂密的森林。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
There are many tourist attractions in this village that you won't be able to find anywhere else. Our fish markets and the unique architecture of our buildings are enough reason to visit Ayotaya.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
村里有许多别处见不到的景点。
光是鱼市和独特的建筑风格，就值得您专程来哎哟泰雅一游。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Please feel free
to take a look around.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
请尽情四处看看。

scripts.text: Building Locations.
scripts.translation: 查看建筑位置

scripts.text: Remove marks from mini-map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Where would
you like to visit?
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
您想去哪里参观？

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 道具店

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒馆

scripts.text: Shrine
scripts.translation: 神庙

scripts.text: Fishing Spot
scripts.translation: 钓鱼点

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Noi]
At our Weapon Shop,
you will find great weapons
favored by brave Ayothayan seafarers.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们的武器店里，有勇敢的哎哟泰雅航海者喜爱的优质武器。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Weapon Shop
is located at ^55FF33+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
武器店位于小地图上的^55FF33+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
We Ayothayans always make sure we have everything we need before we go traveling. It never hurts to be prepared, doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们哎哟泰雅人出门旅行前，总会备齐所需物品。
有备无患，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Tool Shop
is located at ^3355FF+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
道具店位于小地图上的^3355FF+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
One of the basics of adventuring is gathering information, or at least that's what they say. You can meet people from all sorts of places in the Tavern. I'm sure you can learn something useful there.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
大家都说，收集情报是冒险的基本功之一。
酒馆里能遇见来自各地的人，我相信您一定能在那里打听到有用的消息。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Of course, you must
drop by our Tavern.
It is located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
当然，别忘了到我们的酒馆坐坐。
它位于小地图上的^00FF00+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
If you wish to pray to God, or achieve a state of peace in your mind, why don't you visit our Shrine? Even if it's just for sight-seeing, everyone is
welcome there.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
想向神明祈祷，或让心灵平静下来，不妨去神庙看看。
即使只是观光，那里也欢迎每一位访客。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Shrine
is located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
神庙位于小地图上的^00FF00+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Since Ayothaya was built above the surface of the water and close to a beach, it's been a favorite spot for fishermen. Why don't you catch some fish for dinner at the Fishing Spot?
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
哎哟泰雅建在水面上，又靠近海滩，一直很受渔民喜爱。
不如去钓鱼点钓几条鱼，准备晚餐？

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our famous
Fishing Spot
is located at ^00FF00+^000000
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们著名的钓鱼点，位于小地图上的^00FF00+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
If you wish to remove location marks on your mini-map, please select the 'Remove marks from mini-map' command from the menu.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
想清除小地图上的地点标记，请在菜单中选择“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Alright...
I've removed all the
location marks from
your mini-map.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
好的...
小地图上的地点标记已经全部移除了。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Please enjoy
your travels.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
祝您旅途愉快。
